bug.title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
bug.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "A results page is shown with a heading that includes "100% stoneware"."

verdict.title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
verdict.oneLiner: Searching for “100% stoneware” shows an error page instead of a results page.
verdict.rootCause: The search page could not display results for the requested search term and showed an error message instead.
verdict.suggestion: Investigate why the search route for “100% stoneware” enters the error state. Ensure it shows a heading containing the query and either matching products or a no-results message.

flow.title: Searching for a phrase with a percent sign shows results
steps: Type "100% stoneware" into the Search box
expect: A results page is shown with a heading that includes "100% stoneware"
The page says nothing matched or lists products
flow.notes: Breaker's suspicion: server.js:367 calls decodeURIComponent on url.searchParams.get('q'), which URLSearchParams has already decoded. A literal '%' not followed by two hex digits throws URIError: URI malformed, and the catch at server.js:379-384 turns that into the 500 'Something went wrong' page.

kane.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "A results page loads, even if it shows no results."
kane.oneLiner: Searching for `100% off` shows a generic error page instead of a results page.
kane.summary:
The search page cannot handle the supplied search text safely. Rather than showing the query as plain text and returning results or an empty-results state, it shows an error screen.
Investigate search handling for queries containing percent signs and HTML-like markup. Escape the query for display and ensure such input returns a normal results or no-results page rather than the generic error screen.
